mapper.select: SELECT * FROM s_member_balance_lot WHERE venue_customer_id = #{venueCustomerId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND available_amount_fen > 0 AND (type = 'PAID' OR expires_at > #{now}) ORDER BY CASE WHEN type = 'GIFT' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, CASE WHEN type = 'GIFT' THEN expires_at END, id FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM s_member_balance_lot WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM s_member_balance_lot WHERE source_recharge_id = #{rechargeId} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lot.type = 'PAID' AND lot.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN lot.available_amount_fen ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paidBalanceFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lot.type = 'GIFT' AND lot.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lot.expires_at > #{now} THEN lot.available_amount_fen ELSE 0 END), 0) AS giftBalanceFen, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN lot.type = 'GIFT' AND lot.status = 'ACTIVE' AND lot.expires_at = nearest.expires_at THEN lot.available_amount_fen ELSE 0 END), 0) AS nextGiftExpiresAmountFen, nearest.expires_at AS nextGiftExpiresAt FROM s_member_balance_lot lot LEFT JOIN ( SELECT venue_customer_id, MIN(expires_at) AS expires_at FROM s_member_balance_lot WHERE venue_customer_id = #{venueCustomerId} AND type = 'GIFT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND available_amount_fen > 0 AND expires_at > #{now} GROUP BY venue_customer_id ) nearest ON nearest.venue_customer_id = lot.venue_customer_id WHERE lot.venue_customer_id = #{venueCustomerId} GROUP BY nearest.expires_at
SELECT * FROM s_member_balance_lot WHERE type = 'GIFT' AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND available_amount_fen > 0 AND expires_at > #{now} AND expires_at <= #{remindBefore} ORDER BY id LIMIT 200
